subject: Deal queue: price approvals stale — potential forecast impact
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal queue: price approvals stale — potential forecast impact

Team,

Quick heads up from pipeline hygiene: I ran the weekly price-approval sweep and found three deals currently marked as "Committed" in SFDC but with discount approvals expired or never signed off by Deal Desk. If we leave these marked as committed they overstate our Q4 committed forecast by ~$420k ARR.

Summary (attached: stale_discount_tracker.xlsx):
- GreenGrid Systems (GG-2026-0421) — 18% promo discount applied; approval requested 9/28, no response from Deal Desk.
- NovaVault Utilities (NV-2026-0375) — trial-to-paid pricing; verbal approval noted but missing formal econ sign-off.
- Meridian Health (MH-2026-0398) — price redline pending procurement counter.

Ask: Can Deal Desk confirm approval status for these three by EOD Fri? Finance (Vanessa), if approvals aren't documented by Monday morning, please advise whether we should roll these from "Committed" back to "Best Case" for the forecast refresh.

My recommendation: Flag GreenGrid and Meridian as at-risk pending paperwork and adjust commit probability to 40% unless signed DocuSign is in place.

Thanks — I attached the tracker with SFDC record links.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — good catch. I pulled the Deal Desk queue and attached the pending sheet (dealdesk_pendingsheet.csv). A few notes:
- GreenGrid: pricing approval was requested 2026-09-28; Deal Desk marked pended for procurement confirmation. No signed MPA on file.
- NovaVault: pricing decision is verbal between AE and buyer; Deal Desk requested written confirmation as standard practice.
- Meridian: procurement has provided a redlined term sheet; awaiting Deal Desk sign-off on the concession.

I can prioritize GreenGrid for an expedited approval if Sales confirms the concession is aligned to the standard concession band and legal confirms the small redline. Ben — can you confirm? If so I’ll issue an approval memo and ask Finance to accept the commit.

Rishi

Erin — appreciate the update. I reviewed the redline and spoke with Legal — the section tweak is operational and doesn't change pricing or risk profile materially. From Sales' side, the 18% promo stands if Legal signs off (they're already looped).

Action plan:
- Rishi: please provisionally approve the 18% discount subject to final Legal sign-off of the redline; issue the approval memo and notify Finance.
- Erin: if you can complete signature by EOD Mon, we'll keep this as a committed deal for Q4.
- Camila / Vanessa: if paperwork is not executed by Mon EOD, please remove GG-2026-0421 from committed forecast and set close probability to 40%.

I'll follow up with a short note once Legal confirms.

Thanks,
